analysis.title: Cloud Engineer - Professional Services
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong infrastructure engineering experience (capacity planning, performance engineering, AWS migration support) and practical AI automation skills (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic workflows). However, the role requires hands-on AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, ALB, Lambda) and CI/CD pipeline building, which are not directly evidenced in the profile. The candidate's AWS experience is project-based (lakehouse) and not production-proven. SQL and Python are strong, but Windows Server/IIS and Docker are not mentioned. The role's billable consulting context aligns with the candidate's consulting background at CA Technologies.
strengths: Expert-level Python and SQL (Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server) with extensive ETL and data pipeline experience.
Strong capacity planning and forecasting background, directly relevant to infrastructure reliability and monitoring.
Practical AI adoption: used Copilot, Claude Code, and built agentic workflows (job search pipeline, lakehouse Text-to-SQL).
Experience supporting AWS migration (at G6 Hospitality) and designing AWS lakehouse (S3, Glue, Athena, Bedrock).
Consulting experience at CA Technologies, delivering client-facing solutions and training.
Automation mindset: automated reporting, ETL, and forecasting processes.
gaps: No direct evidence of hands-on AWS infrastructure engineering (EC2, S3, ALB, Lambda) in a production environment.
No demonstrated CI/CD pipeline development (GitHub Actions or similar).
No mention of Docker or containerization experience.
No Windows Server or IIS experience indicated.
Infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation) not evidenced in professional work.
tailoring_plan: 1. Rewrite resume summary to highlight infrastructure engineering, automation, and AI workflow experience, positioning as a builder. 2. Add a 'Cloud & Automation' section listing AWS lakehouse project, AWS migration support, and AI pipeline projects. 3. Emphasize Python/SQL expertise and automation of repetitive tasks. 4. Mention consulting experience at CA Technologies to align with billable consulting. 5.
